company.name: LaunchDarkly
company.shortDescription: LaunchDarkly is a feature management platform that allows software development teams to deliver to their customers.
company.description: LaunchDarkly is a feature management platform that allows development teams to fundamentally transform their software delivery to customers. With the ability to gradually release new software features to any segment of users on any platform, DevOps teams can standardize safe releases at scale, accelerate their journey to the cloud, and collaborate with business teams.

productsAndServices.description: A system to control software feature releases by toggling features on or off in real time without redeploying code.
productsAndServices.name: Feature Flags

productsAndServices.description: A tool to monitor software releases, detect performance issues, and automatically remediate problems before they affect customers.
productsAndServices.name: Release Automation

productsAndServices.description: A platform to run A/B tests and multivariate experiments, analyze feature performance, and optimize product decisions based on data.
productsAndServices.name: Experimentation & Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A service to manage and iterate AI model configurations and prompts in production without redeploying applications.
productsAndServices.name: AI Engineering

productsAndServices.description: Consulting and implementation services to help organizations integrate LaunchDarkly SDKs and adopt feature management best practices.
productsAndServices.name: Application Readiness Professional Services

productsAndServices.description: A suite of connectors and plugins that link LaunchDarkly with third-party tools for development, collaboration, analytics, and deployment.
productsAndServices.name: Integrations
